name: I2v.ai
description: Official server for 12 image and 16 video generation models: list models, estimate cost, submit jobs with a capped `maxCostUsd` and an `idempotencyKey`, then poll results. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth 2.1 or API key; local stdio via `npx -y @i2v-ai/cli mcp` with `I2V_API_KEY`; MIT. Endpoint: `https://i2v.ai/api/mcp` · [Docs](https://i2v.ai/docs/mcp) · Registry: `io.github.i2v-ai/mcp`
